name: Sticky Notes
author: Tahsin005
description: Colorful sticky notes in a bento-style bar panel: 8-color palette, search filter, drag-and-drop reordering, pin, resize and delete notes; Ctrl+N new note, Ctrl+F search, Esc closes. Saved to ~/.local/share/omarchy-sticky-notes/notes.json.

barWidget.description: A panel of colorful sticky notes you can type into, laid out as a bento board with search and reordering.
